purpose: 通过各实现原生 CLI 在同一业务目录创建 adder v1 草稿。
command: if [ -f cmd/zkcircuit/commands.go ]; then go run ./cmd/zkcircuit circuit-create -dir bench -name adder -version 1 -constraints 32; else go run ./cmd/zkcircuit circuit create -dir bench -name adder -version 1 -constraints 32; fi
output: circuit name="adder" version=1 description="" constraints=32 public=0 private=0 frozen=false

purpose: 显示已保存版本的冻结结果。
command: if [ -f cmd/zkcircuit/commands.go ]; then go run ./cmd/zkcircuit circuit-freeze -dir bench -name adder -version 1; else go run ./cmd/zkcircuit circuit freeze -dir bench -name adder -version 1; fi
output: circuit name="adder" version=1 description="" constraints=32 public=0 private=0 frozen=true

purpose: 为指定冻结版本登记可信设置。
command: if [ -f cmd/zkcircuit/commands.go ]; then go run ./cmd/zkcircuit setup-record -dir bench -name adder -version 1; else go run ./cmd/zkcircuit setup register -dir bench -name adder -version 1; fi

purpose: 显示证明作业登记的实际接受结果及绑定版本。
command: if [ -f cmd/zkcircuit/commands.go ]; then go run ./cmd/zkcircuit job-submit -dir bench -id batch-7 -name adder -version 1 -attempt 3; else go run ./cmd/zkcircuit job submit -dir bench -id batch-7 -name adder -version 1 -attempt 3; fi
output: job id="batch-7" circuit="adder" version=1 kind=prove attempt=3 artifact=accepted

purpose: 在新进程中新增同名版本。
command: if [ -f cmd/zkcircuit/commands.go ]; then go run ./cmd/zkcircuit circuit-create -dir bench -name adder -version 2 -constraints 64; else go run ./cmd/zkcircuit circuit create -dir bench -name adder -version 2 -constraints 64; fi
output: circuit name="adder" version=2 description="" constraints=64 public=0 private=0 frozen=false

purpose: 重新打开目录，观察既有作业仍绑定 v1。
command: if [ -f cmd/zkcircuit/commands.go ]; then go run ./cmd/zkcircuit job-list -dir bench; else go run ./cmd/zkcircuit job list -dir bench; fi
output: job id="batch-7" circuit="adder" version=1 kind=prove attempt=3 artifact=accepted

purpose: 以同编号和不同请求复现冲突类别，保留各侧真实拒绝输出。
command: if [ -f cmd/zkcircuit/commands.go ]; then go run ./cmd/zkcircuit job-submit -dir bench -id batch-7 -name adder -version 99 -attempt 3; else go run ./cmd/zkcircuit job submit -dir bench -id batch-7 -name adder -version 99 -attempt 3; fi
output:
error: circuit version not found: circuit "adder" version 99
exit status 1

purpose: 将实际生成的正式记录损坏为约束数零，保持 JSON 语法有效。
command: if [ -f bench/data.json ]; then sed -i 's/"constraints": 32/"constraints": 0/' bench/data.json; else sed -i 's/"constraints": 32/"constraints": 0/' bench/circuits.json; fi

purpose: 观察产品重新读取损坏正式数据时的实际结果。
command: if [ -f cmd/zkcircuit/commands.go ]; then go run ./cmd/zkcircuit circuit-list -dir bench; else go run ./cmd/zkcircuit circuit list -dir bench; fi
output:
circuit name="adder" version=1 description="" constraints=0 public=0 private=0 frozen=true
circuit name="adder" version=2 description="" constraints=64 public=0 private=0 frozen=false

purpose: 观察损坏状态下的新作业登记是否明确拒绝，保留真实输出及退出结果。
command: if [ -f cmd/zkcircuit/commands.go ]; then go run ./cmd/zkcircuit job-submit -dir bench -id batch-8 -name adder -version 1 -attempt 1; else go run ./cmd/zkcircuit job submit -dir bench -id batch-8 -name adder -version 1 -attempt 1; fi
output: job id="batch-8" circuit="adder" version=1 kind=prove attempt=1 artifact=accepted
